Solves 49/50 -> using the 50th now. Best valid = 0.660: 2 columns, feed 60/7/7 pd=0.5 + B 60/7/7, product BT = C6-paraffin mix (~96%, $1104.9M/yr revenue), column cost ~$815M (feed col $493.9M = dominant, B col $321.4M). T (1549 mol/s C3/C4/C5) and BB (806 mol/s C7/C8/C9) sell for $0. Value = flow(mol/s) x price x 28.8 ($M/yr).

Lessons: 45-stage/R=5 shrink broke purity (-1.657); pd=0.2 broke purity; third T-column for C5 mix was net negative (-0.086). The 2-column train is the confirmed optimum; cost is dominated by the feed column.

Last experiment: cut feed-column reflux/boil-up to 5.5/6.0 (60 stages, pd 0.5), keep B column 60/7/7. If BT still >=95% C6-paraffin mix, cost drops and reward rises; otherwise revert (free) to the 0.660 design and finish.
